notablePrerequisites: You do not control a Keimi token.
description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, targeting Tatsunari.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi creature token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Keimi, adding {G}.
When Keimi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
